title: The Lid
text: "On the moon's far side there's a door the size of a valley. Our people called it the Lid. Whatever burned them is under it."

lines.text: "Our caretaker gave us the code to it, the last sol before it stopped being ours. We never had a ship to use it."
"I've put it in a recording for you. If you ever stand at that door, play it. Don't make an old woman regret it."

choices.label: Take the recording
choices.reply: Stored: one recording, and inside it forty-one characters in our own key format. We look at it for a long time.

choices.label: Promise her
choices.reply: "Don't promise," says Sefa. "Your kind always promises. Just remember."
